from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
import hashlib
import json
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

root = Path('products/distribution/sqlite-paid-education-shelf')
source = root / 'raw/sqlite-listing-navigation.xml'
content = source.read_bytes()
candidates = []
seen = set()
items = ET.fromstring(content).findall('./channel/item')
for item in items:
    link = (item.findtext('link') or '').strip()
    parsed = urlsplit(link)
    if parsed.scheme != 'https' or parsed.hostname not in {'leanpub.com', 'www.leanpub.com'} or parsed.username or parsed.password or parsed.path in {'', '/'}:
        continue
    clean = f'https://{parsed.hostname}{parsed.path.rstrip("/")}'
    if clean in seen:
        continue
    seen.add(clean)
    candidates.append({'url': clean, 'search_title': (item.findtext('title') or '').strip()[:240]})
report = {'source': str(source), 'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest(), 'rss_items': len(items), 'direct_first_party_links': candidates[:3], 'scope': 'Navigation only. Original storefront pages govern scope, price, sample access and any evidence of buyer activity.'}
out = root / 'first-party-navigation.json'
out.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(out.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
